title: Trigonometric Function
text: Specified trigonometric function on input, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Function} sets Trigonometric function; {Approximation method} sets the cORDIC, Lookup, {Interpolation method} sets the method of interpolation between breakpoint values Linear, {Number of iterations}, {Angle unit}, {Number of data points}, {Output signal type} sets the complexity of output signal, {Remove protection against out-of-range input}, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the interval between samples, {Table data type} sets the data type of table, {Mode} sets the category of data, {Signedness} sets the signed, {Scaling} sets the method for scaling fixed-point data Binary, {Data type override} sets the data type override mode for this signal, {Word length} sets the bit size of the word that holds the quantized and {Fraction length} sets the fraction length for fixed-point data type. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: x -axis or real part of the function argument for atan2 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Specified trigonometric function of input scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: sin
ports.summary: Sine of input signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: cos
ports.summary: Cosine of input signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Function
params.values: Trigonometric function sin (default) | cos | tan | asin | acos | atan | atan2 | sinh | cosh | tanh | asinh | acosh | atanh | sincos | cos + jsin

params.name: Approximation method
params.values: CORDIC, Lookup, or none None (default) | CORDIC | Lookup

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: Method of interpolation between breakpoint values Linear point-slope (default) | Flat

params.name: Number of iterations
params.values: Number of iterations for CORDIC algorithm 11 (default) | positive integer, less than or equal to word length of fixed-point input

params.name: Number of data points
params.values: Number of data points for lookup table 16 (default) | scalar

params.name: Output signal type
params.values: Complexity of output signal auto (default) | real | complex

params.name: Remove protection against out-of-range input
params.values: Remove protection against out-of-range input off (default) | on

params.name: Table data type
params.values: Data type of table Inherit: Inherit via input (default) | double | single | fixdt(1,16,0) |

params.name: Mode
params.values: Category of data to specify Inherit (default) | Built in | Fixed point | Expression

params.name: Signedness
params.values: Specify signed or unsigned Signed (default) | Unsigned

params.name: Scaling
params.values: Method for scaling fixed-point data Binary point (default)

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Specify data type override mode for this signal Inherit | Off

params.name: Word length
params.values: Bit size of the word that holds the quantized integer 16 (default) | integer from 0 to 32

params.name: Fraction length
params.values: Specify fraction length for fixed-point data type 0 (default) | scalar integer
